_doc: The start area round base 1 (Verdance's Landing Yard). See docs/ADJUSTING.md. radius_m: hexes whose centre is this close to the start pad hold only junk Lumi lifts at the start, and no big wreck, drum, barrel or heap stands there. leftover_from: a hex this far cleaned whose last pieces are all hidden or out of reach counts as clean. heal_from: a saved start-area hex this far cleaned but stuck heals once on load.
